name: Ralph
description: CMDB and asset management system for tracking data center and office hardware.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_NAME: ralph
      DATABASE_USER: ralph
      DATABASE_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      DATABASE_PASSWORD: {{env.DATABASE_PASSWORD}}
      SECRET_KEY: {{env.SECRET_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/media:/var/local/ralph/media
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ralph
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.DATABASE_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: ralph
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
